voice.summary: Sounds like a studio statement in italic serif: brief, composed and never loud. It lets the reveal, the pause and the work do the persuading.
dos: Use fewer than ten words per line
Favour verbs like design, create and inspire

boilerplate: Studio Mara is an independent design studio whose 2026 portfolio presents selected work with a minimal, motion-led reveal and an unhurried, italic serif voice.

logo.note: A simple orbiting ring reflects a circling loader and a small studio mark.
